name: IBM-PS22-Interview-Trainer-Agent
description: IBM University Engagement Project — Problem Statement No. 22. An AI-powered Interview Trainer Agent using RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and IBM Granite (ibm/granite-4-h-small) on IBM watsonx.ai. Generates role-specific question sets, preparation strategies, answer evaluations, and adaptive mock interview sessions.
tagline: Practice Smarter. Answer Better. Get Interview Ready with AI.

stack.resume_parsing: pypdf + NLP regex + IBM Granite AI summary

endpoints.description: Serve the main interview trainer UI (5-tab web app)
Health check — returns model, RAG doc count, config status
Generate personalized question set with model answers and tips
Score and improve a candidate answer using IBM Granite
Start an adaptive mock interview session — returns first question
Submit answer, receive feedback and next question
Get the full performance report for a completed session
Get current status of an active mock session
Parse pasted resume text into a structured candidate profile
Upload a resume file (PDF / DOCX / TXT) for parsing and RAG indexing

run.setup_env: cp env.example .env  # then fill in IBM_WATSONX_API_KEY and IBM_WATSONX_PROJECT_ID

files.app/granite_client.py: IBM watsonx.ai /text/chat HTTP client with 429 retry
files.app/rag_pipeline.py: ChromaDB vector store — 64-document knowledge base across 10 roles
files.app/resume_parser.py: NLP + AI resume parser (regex + Granite summary)
files.static/index.html: Single-page UI with 5 tabs (Mock Interview, Questions, Strategy, Evaluator, Resume)
files.run.py: Entry point with port-check and auto-fallback
files.tests/test_agent.py: 9 unit tests for core agent logic
